scope: Human-reviewed semantics and dependency descriptions; all frequencies, identities, source receipts and line numbers are generated. No runtime alias is installed by this file.

excluded_sources.reason: Historical identities, not live selectable entries. Still used by rehab_completion_service via archived_rehab_drill_by_id; PRESERVE history.
Test fixtures, not live banks or policies. Production source scan excludes tests/cases.
Obsolete predecessor, absent from current tracked data. Source-reference scan checks active code; technical_footwork_bank.json is the live source.
Untracked nested local copies in original checkout, excluded by isolated Main worktree and tracked-source inventory.

value_decisions.canonical: battle_ropes
value_decisions.meaning: Singular/plural equipment name for battle-rope apparatus. Rope Climb Sprints also carries battle_rope alongside climbing_rope: that association needs separate correction review; never equate climbing rope and battle ropes.
evidence: conditioning_bank.json: Battle Rope Gauntlet lists both forms and explicitly says Requires: Battle Ropes.
training_context.known_equipment contains both forms; EQUIP_ALIASES only maps spaced battle rope, leaving underscored battle_rope divergent.

value_decisions.canonical: double_end_bag
value_decisions.meaning: Separator variants of the same double-end boxing bag; distinct from heavy bag. Current equipment normalisation does not collapse this hyphen.
evidence: Style conditioning Precision Under Pace uses double-end_bag; conditioning Double-End Bag Precision Rhythm uses double_end_bag.

value_decisions.canonical: kettlebell with quantity retained separately when known
value_decisions.meaning: Same apparatus identity with inconsistent plurality. A single/pair prescription must remain in instructions or a future explicit quantity, not be inferred from plurality.
evidence: training_context.EQUIP_ALIASES explicitly maps kettlebells to kettlebell.
Conditioning Single-Arm KB Snatch lists kettlebells despite explicitly single-arm work.

value_decisions.canonical: weight_vest
value_decisions.meaning: Two names for a wearable weight vest; preserve loading instructions.
evidence: training_context.EQUIP_ALIASES maps weighted_vest to weight_vest.

value_decisions.canonical: rower
value_decisions.meaning: Apparatus identity is the rowing ergometer; this does not make different session doses interchangeable.
evidence: training_context.EQUIP_ALIASES maps rowing_machine to rower; conditioning machine-equipment set includes both.

value_decisions.canonical: candidate mat capability; review protective thickness and contact context
value_decisions.meaning: Likely naming redundancy, but ground-combat mats and rehab supports must retain suitability requirements. The current normaliser leaves the two distinct.
evidence: Style conditioning uses mat for grappling/standup and mats for Shot to Granby Roll; rehab also uses mat. No shared mat specification exists.

value_decisions.canonical: resistance_band family with mini_band subtype and strength/setup requirements
value_decisions.meaning: Bands share a resistance-equipment family, but mini-loop and long resistance bands are not automatically interchangeable. Runtime broad aliases describe capability, not identical exercise setup.
evidence: training_context.EQUIP_ALIASES collapses mini_band/resistance_band into bands; rehab sources retain mini_band for regional activation.
The example band has no live catalogue occurrences; it exists in the runtime alias map.

value_decisions.canonical: pads capability with typed apparatus subtype
value_decisions.meaning: Existing shared contract defines one handheld striking-pad capability. Exact implements remain distinct for exercise execution; foam pad and generic pad must not acquire striking-pad semantics.
evidence: shared/equipment-aliases.json pads contract and training_context pad contract comments explicitly exclude rehab foam pads and generic squeeze pad.

value_decisions.canonical: cycle_ergometer family with fan/upright/recumbent subtypes
value_decisions.meaning: Shared cycling family with different apparatus and loading. Existing echo/bike_erg aliases reflect broad athlete capability, not identical mechanics.
evidence: training_context aliases echo_bike and bike_erg to assault_bike; conditioning machine-preference set lists multiple distinct devices.

value_decisions.canonical: candidate cable_machine identity; review cable attachment/setup semantics
value_decisions.meaning: Runtime capability alias exists, but source cable could denote attachment rather than a complete station. Do not merge solely from alias behaviour.
evidence: training_context.EQUIP_ALIASES cable_machine->cable.

value_decisions.canonical: adductors as anatomical identifier, retaining training/loading dimensions
value_decisions.meaning: Both denote the hip-adductor muscle group in these source associations. Mobility and loaded adduction remain different exercises and doses.
evidence: Adductor rock-back carries adductor and body_region groin_adductor; Copenhagen Adduction and Adductor Squeeze Isometric carry adductors.

value_decisions.canonical: upper_back
value_decisions.meaning: Whitespace variant of the same region, with safety-sensitive exact regional comparisons and historical evidence validation.
evidence: rehab bank declares both forms; rehab_selector._regions_match lowercases but does not replace spaces; injury_location_registry supplies canonical region identities.

value_decisions.canonical: candidate biceps identifier; align with injury_location_registry and historical exposures first
value_decisions.meaning: Likely singular/plural anatomy redundancy. Region identity is a clinical join key; source spelling must be reconciled with parser aliases and frozen exposure evidence.
evidence: Rehab bank target_regions includes both; RehabExposureEvent validates target_regions against injury_location_registry.

value_decisions.canonical: candidate hamstring region under existing injury location registry
value_decisions.meaning: Likely anatomy redundancy, but clinical region keys and history require a separate migration review.
evidence: rehab_selector.filter_rehab_candidates uses region compatibility as a non-tradeable gate.

value_decisions.canonical: possible shared hand_foot_timing filter with directional source values retained pending review
value_decisions.meaning: Search already groups these for discovery. Grappling hand-fight/snapdown and striking foot/hand sequences differ; evidence does not establish identical directional semantics.
evidence: coordination/grappling.json grapple.handfight_snap_reaction uses hand_foot_timing; striking/kick sequences use foot_hand_timing.
training_library_vocabulary Hand and foot timing accepts both for search; coordination relevance scores raw qualities.

value_decisions.canonical: neck parent, vestibular focus separate from anatomical region
value_decisions.meaning: Neck anatomy and vestibular sensorimotor focus must not be merged into one adaptation or loading claim.
evidence: Exercise bank vestibular support combines neck/vestibular context; generic neck control rows do not establish vestibular training.

value_decisions.canonical: body_region full_body plus explicit stance/control focus; preserve legacy lookup until parity verified
value_decisions.meaning: Combines whole-body anatomy and stance task in one region token. It is not a synonym for every full_body exercise.
evidence: Boxer stance weight-shift hold declares full_body_stance while category balance and goals readiness/mobility/balance describe task intent.

value_decisions.canonical: candidate ordered-independent regional array after instructions review
value_decisions.meaning: Same word set may represent multi-region focus, but exercise execution and progression need review before collapsing order.
evidence: Both are accepted by explicit hip/ankle mobility discovery rules. Current body facets retain each compound token.

value_decisions.canonical: candidate rotation movement identifier; retain mechanics/goal distinctions
value_decisions.meaning: Potential noun/adjective terminology inconsistency. Do not replace anti-rotation with rotation or treat all rotation as power.
evidence: training_library_vocabulary rotational power explicitly accepts both only with additional power and upper-body context.

value_decisions.canonical: reaction cue-response; reactive reviewed source quality; mech_reactive loading mechanics
value_decisions.meaning: Cognitive cue-response and stretch/rebound loading are distinct. Existing broad TAG_SYNONYMS mapping reactive decision to reactive must be reviewed separately, not propagated into Goal verification.
evidence: training_catalogue_aliases reaction rationale excludes rebound mechanics; training_library_vocabulary reaction rule excludes mech_reactive.
injury_filtering mechanism keywords and late-conditioning safe-tag rules consume reactive mechanics/legacy tokens differently.

value_decisions.canonical: grip goal/quality only with intent evidence; grip mechanisms in safety dimension
value_decisions.meaning: Grip development, required hand support and intense/crush loading are different claims; source grip associations need per-row intent review.
evidence: training_library_vocabulary Grip work excludes grip-support risk alone; injury_filtering includes separate grip risk families.

value_decisions.canonical: goal power separate from method power and mechanical ballistic demand
value_decisions.meaning: A training objective, chosen execution method and force/loading mechanics cannot share evidentiary authority merely because they overlap.
evidence: Strength bank method power occurs without explicit goals; discovery power rules require context and exclude risk alone.

value_decisions.canonical: dedicated mechanical_risk_tags retaining compatibility copies until all consumers switch
value_decisions.meaning: Mechanical mechanisms are duplicated in mixed tags and the risk array. Injury and planner consumers still read tags, so deleting copies would change safety behaviour.
evidence: injury_filtering.injury_match_details reads tags plus inferred/expanded mechanisms; bank_schema and strength/conditioning rules consume tags.

value_decisions.canonical: candidate alactic identifier retaining exact dose and support-alias distinctions
value_decisions.meaning: Same broad energy-system family, but canonical replacement must preserve conditioning.normalise_system aliases, quota and late-window logic. Naming alone cannot equate doses.
evidence: conditioning.normalize_system uses SYSTEM_ALIASES; bank_schema._system_state has its own aliases; discovery short explosive efforts accepts all three.

value_decisions.meaning: Broad prevention claim lacks a verified effect merely from an exercise name or risk classification. Requires qualified evidence review; do not broaden search synonyms into clinical promises.
evidence: Explicit source goals on four strength entries are declarations, not evidence certification; source row and related guidance are retained.

value_decisions.canonical: review each setup into all_of or any_of; do not flatten alternatives
value_decisions.meaning: Comma-separated raw single tokens hide equipment grouping. Simultaneous fixtures (trap bar/pins) differ from alternatives (landmine/medicine ball); punctuation alone cannot decide.
evidence: training_context._split_items splits commas and slashes alike; catalogue equipment facets keep compound strings literal.

value_decisions.canonical: review explicit any_of alternatives versus all_of combined setup
value_decisions.meaning: Slash is overloaded: treadmill/rower suggests alternatives, sledgehammer/tire a simultaneous setup. Preserve raw tokens until the named exercise and guidance establish grouping.
evidence: Rotational Sledgehammer Strike names paired apparatus; normalise_equipment_list currently turns both slash forms into multiple requirements.

consumer_workflows.meaning: Shared pads aliases map saved athlete capability values before option hydration; unknown values pass through here and can later be discarded by retainKnownOptionValues. This does not verify an exercise apparatus requirement.
Option labels use exact source option values plus legacy labels. New display labels must remain separate from persisted capability identifiers.
Checkbox selection reads shared intake option values exactly. Catalogue filter grouping must not rewrite the athlete equipment capability contract.

Server facet values are sent unchanged under goal/equipment/body_focus/sport/type query keys. Labels and readable names are display only; no client-side goal verification or prescription permission is created.

Preview retrieves the pinned catalogue ID, displays generic guidance and media, and preserves unspecified versus empty equipment. The category boundary retains discovery/rehab/learning scope; displayed stop/progress guidance is not an enforced clinical permission.
All raw fields retained; identity row hash changes on any metadata edit. Explicit manifest rebinding must preserve existing UUIDs.
TAG_SYNONYMS plus lowercase/hyphen/space handling; normalisation is not semantic validation. Consumers call it for broader focus inputs too.
Commas/slashes/pluses/and are flattened before aliases. Strength/conditioning/coordination equipment checks compare canonical sets. Rehab selector uses a different reader.
Normalised goal/weakness/style/phase intersections contribute weights; missing required equipment prevents eligibility. Anatomical tag cleanup can change priority scores.
Source bank candidate filtering, phase membership, context/injury/equipment gating and scoring, then prescription assembly.
Fight-proximity safety uses explicit costs, known equipment and tags; d1 equipment block is absolute. False low-cost declarations can affect selection.
Runtime movement detection differs from raw catalogue metadata. Missing movement is not permission to add a goal.
Lowercase aliases and mixed-token precedence; glycolytic wins mixed known systems. Separate bank_schema aliases also exist.
Selects general/style/taper sources with phase/system/equipment/injury constraints and style-specific score weights.
Explicit source sport tag exact match adds sport-specific ranking bonus; spelling changes can alter ranking.
Late conditioning eligibility depends on system/dose/cost/freshness evidence; aliases must preserve quota and safety outputs.
Missing/unknown metadata can block late training; low-risk support has separate fallbacks. Generic defaults must not be treated as raw source evidence.
Runtime/audit/strict modes differ. This metadata audit avoids these loaders to preserve raw null/missing values.
Coordination adapter normalises sport/style/quality tokens and equipment; dedicated support bank is not an anchor bank.
Support selection filters equipment, sport/phase/late window and injury safety, then ranks explicit target relevance.
Technical footwork uses a dedicated timed-or-quality-rep dose contract and cue-source permissions; must not inherit generic conditioning defaults.
Turns technical movement and side/dose metadata into exact instructions; cue execution is context-dependent.
Raw tags plus name-inferred/expanded mechanisms drive injury risk matching. low_impact removes running_volume_high before matching; contradictory metadata is safety-sensitive.
Normalised/inferred injury tags and text feed severity/phase/fatigue thresholds; clinical and surface gates can block selection.
Explicit clinical restrictions are evaluated separately from injury severity and cannot be traded against ranking.
Clinical region/type/stage/side/severity constraints precede ranking. Equipment is lowercased raw values, without planner alias/splitting rules; unknown required region fails closed.
Declared function overrides legacy keyword classification only if valid; missing declaration remains fallback evidence.
Rehab group location/type and phase progression select pathway candidates. Group metadata is not an independent exercise count.
Active policy binds exact bank content and instructions/dose/criteria. Changing a row invalidates prescription bank hashes; cannot silently regenerate safety evidence.
Pathway family and regional profile compose stage transitions; baseline constraints remain explicit.
Policy requirements and recorded observations qualify transitions. Raw bank demand is not proof of tolerance; unknown demand does not provide positive progression evidence.
Clearance scopes, active policy and injury episode govern rehab/contact permission; search facets grant none.
Recorded exposure target_regions must be recognised and include the injury body region; anatomical renames affect historical contracts.
Surface instructions require reviewed hashes; never treat wound-care rows as physical rehab drills.
Completion service recovers archived retired IDs without remapping; archive is excluded from live catalogue but cannot be deleted.
Generic fields may be absent in raw banks but defaulted into selection payloads. Definitions are included in policy constants inventory; defaults are not verified source facts.
Completed session evidence uses reported RPE/pain or external hard effort plus actual duration, not catalogue goal/tag counts; no inferred minutes-to-RPE conversion.
Known raw goals plus aliases/context conjunctions produce current facets; equipment compounds remain raw. No prescription permission.
Selected filter strings compare exactly with facet sets; universal sport broadens only sport filtering.
NFKD/casefold/token matching and reviewed intent groups; discovery phrases are not source metadata and cannot create verified goals.
Reviewed AND groups with OR alternatives accept explicit raw tokens; different evidence standard from training/clinical selection.
Media key derives from exercise name; metadata-only updates preserve keys, name changes may not. Catalogue source identity is separately pinned.
Curated public.exercise_media lookup uses existing normalised identity; no database data queried by audit.
Style family and sport ownership select phase-specific educational content; cross_sport and generic fallbacks have explicit order. pressure_fighter maps to brawler for boxing context only.
Mindset/progress instructions are educational evidence, not physical load or verified exercise goals; professional overlays alter cognitive instruction depth.
Countdown day plus sport/style ownership selects governed mental rehearsal. Every countdown has exactly one cross_sport generic fallback; these values cannot be retired casually.
Range-valued duration and pre-bout guidance are retained as mental rehearsal, not physical exercise prescription.

GOAL_NORMALIZER looks up the stripped original case before lowercasing its result; Speed maps to reactive while speed maps to speed. Weakness lookup lowercases first. Case-collision review must preserve or explicitly change documented programming intent.
Round-based authored interval is replaced by athlete round length; elapsed rest falls between rounds. Source duration, effective dose and actual completed minutes have different meanings.
Completion captures observed bank demand; unknown/missing/invalid levels remain unknown and cannot be laundered into clinical tolerance claims.
An actual measured amount is distinguished from unspecified dose. Catalogued instructions alone do not prove completed exposure.
Nested mindset fields are loaded into typed tactical cards and rendered, retaining explicit sport/style/phase context.
GUIDANCE_FIELDS dynamically selects raw known values, including pro_tip and combat_carryover. Displayed guidance is not an enforced restriction.
Equipment notes contribute to late-window mechanics/safety text; they are also displayed, so equipment terminology is not merely a filter concern.
